title: Register a battery by chat, CLI and dashboard
goal: A new battery can be added without an export from the old app
acceptance: Test committed first: "nuova batteria 9 blu LiPo 6S 1300 mAh" (and the English form) registers it and asks for per-cell resistance
`nerv batteries add` does the same from the CLI; the dashboard has an add form
With no batteries, the dashboard panel shows how to add one instead of hiding
privacy: Owner fleet and kitchen data stay local-only; tests use invented batteries, drones and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-20: a chat phrase, a CLI subcommand and a small form over the existing register(). Not a measurement.
